top_signals.title: Tech Rally Stalls as Oil Snaps Four-Day Losing Run: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rally in technology stocks came to a halt as oil resumed its role in setting the tone, with Brent heading for its first gain in a week as traders waited to see whether diplomatic efforts could yield progress toward ending the US-Iran war.

top_signals.title: War Is Now A Core Risk Category For Data Centre Operators
top_signals.summary: As data centres scale, consume more power, and draw tighter community scrutiny, insurance risks are becoming increasingly complex. As AI infrastructure grows, so do legal risks: large lawsuits involving data centres more than tripled from four in all of 2021 to 14 in the first half of 2026, according to a Howden report. Planning and environmental disputes are the main drivers of recent legal disputes. While noise and nuisance complaints, including those concerning diesel generator emissions and water consumption, have also become increasingly common,…
